Types

LayoutTables = ref object
  gsubDone*: bool            ## True once GSUB parsing was attempted.
  gsub*: Option[GsubData]    ## Parsed GSUB table, if present.
  gposDone*: bool            ## True once GPOS parsing was attempted.
  gpos*: Option[GposData]    ## Parsed GPOS table, if present.
  kernDone*: bool            ## True once kern parsing was attempted.
  kern*: Option[KernData]    ## Parsed kern table, if present.
Lazily parsed layout tables, shared through ShaperFont copies (same pattern as the outline cache). Table bytes are immutable per parsed font and parsing ignores the variation location (applied later from varCoords), so no invalidation is needed. 
ShaperFont = ref object
  font*: SfntFont            ## Parsed font.
  unitsPerEm*: uint16        ## Design units per em.
  scale*: Scale              ## Active scale.
  outlineCache*: OutlineCache ## Shared outline cache.
  layout*: LayoutTables      ## Shared layout table cache.
  varCoords*: seq[float32]   ## Normalized variation coordinates.
Shaper handle over a parsed font (HarfBuzz hb_font_t equivalent). A ref so copies share state instead of deep-copying megabytes of font bytes per call. Sharing is observable: setScale and setVariations mutate the shared object, so callers needing isolation must create separate shapers via newShaperFont.

                   vars: openArray[tuple[tag: uint32, value: float32]]) {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Sets the variation location from user-space axis values. Unknown tags are ignored; unspecified axes reset to default. Cached outlines are keyed by glyph only, so the cache is replaced to avoid serving default-location outlines at the new location (copies holding the old handle keep their own location's cache).
